runs.platform_message: GitHub Models is temporarily unavailable as part of a scheduled retirement brownout.

repair.strategy: migrate the activation proof to GitHub Copilot CLI with ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN and copilot-requests: write; do not grant repository write permissions

lesson: Do not repeatedly repair client code when independent transports return the same platform retirement signal. Treat the upstream service as obsolete, retain one failure lesson, and migrate to the vendor-supported successor without carrying deprecated assumptions forward.
disposition: retain_minimal_failure_lesson; raw failed-run scratch remains disposable
